_about: SINGLE-TRANSLATION SHELF: the third shelf of one-off English translations of fiction, plays and verse, mostly from the 1920s: Luo Guanzhong's Romance of the Three Kingdoms (Brewitt-Taylor, 1925), Remarque's All Quiet on the Western Front (Wheen, 1929), Hesse's Steppenwolf (Creighton, 1929), Rølvaag's Giants in the Earth (1927), Thomas Mann's Death in Venice (Kenneth Burke, 1925), Čapek's Krakatit, Kivi's Seven Brothers, Mauriac's Thérèse and The Kiss to the Leper, Undset's The Bridal Wreath, Couperus's Eline Vere, Multatuli's Max Havelaar, Rolland's Annette and Sylvie, Merezhkovsky's Akhnaton, Morand, Natsume's Unhuman Tour, Tanizaki, Bettauer's The City Without Jews, Norbert Jacques's Dr. Mabuse, Leroux, Rousseau's Eloisa (Kenrick, 1761), Kotzebue's Virgin of the Sun, Nodier's Bibliomaniac, George Sand, Auerbach's Little Barefoot, Andreyev's plays, Hauptmann, Hebbel's Three Plays, D'Annunzio's Daughter of Jorio, Lope de Vega's New Art of Writing Plays, Goethe and Schiller's Xenions, Michelangelo's sonnets (Newell), Petrarch (Agnes Tobin), Shevchenko's Kobzar, Hálek, the Prem Sagur, Mary of Nimmegen, the Táin (Mary Hutton), Pearse's collected works, Louÿs's Songs of Bilitis, Swedish, French, Costa Rican and Arabian tales, and Voynich's The Humour of Russia and Stories from Garshin (1893), and Rowland Smith's Garshin, The Signal (1912); the two Garshins added in round 109; and Żeromski's Ashes (Helen Stankiewicz Zand, 1928, 2 vols), added in round 110. Each title gates on its own translator (_surname_by_slug). US public domain. Added 2026-10-10 by lane C (round 44); Adam may veto. No uids minted. Round 120 (2026-10-23, vetoable) added Chamot's Leskov, The Sentry (1923), and Ralston's Turgenev, Liza (1869). Round 121 (2026-10-23, vetoable) added Butts and Browne's Turgenev, Spring Floods and A Lear of the Steppe (1874), Pasvolsky's Kuprin, The Bracelet of Garnets (1917), Tollemache's Russian Sketches (1913), Baskerville's Gogol, Taras Bulba (1907), and Telfer's Pushkin, Russian Romance (1875). Round 124 (2026-10-23, vetoable) added Vikelas twice, Loukis Laras (J. Gennadius, 1881) and Tales from the Aegean (Leonard Eckstein Opdycke, 1894). Round 125 (2026-10-23, vetoable) added Jensen's Gradiva (Helen M. Downey, 1918). Round 126 (2026-10-23, vetoable) added Undset's The Mistress of Husaby (Charles Archer, Grosset & Dunlap fourth printing, December 1928) and Juhani Aho's Squire Hellman and Other Stories (R. Nisbet Bain, 1893).

_verified_note: Evidence that each source's rights/identity line was read (lane C review fix, 2026-10-02, pipeline run over the fetched files; no book text recorded). PG: the header's Translator: line and the COPYRIGHTED marker. IA: whether the translator's name appears in the first 30 KB of OCR, and the years printed in the first 15 KB of front matter (scanner/digitizer lines skipped). Any post-1930 year there was examined by eye; see the title's scan_edition.
